title: artemisia trifurcata subsp. tacomensis
intro: Artemisia trifurcata subsp. tacomensis, commonly known as Mountain Sagewort, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe irritated skin, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Artemisia trifurcata subsp. tacomensis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
